text:
tara (sales): Quick Q — AcmeHealth POC wants EU + APAC only. Do we have a short region-by-region sub-processor list and any APAC edge exclusions? They also asked if BYOK/KMS is available in ap-southeast-1, and whether we can provide IP whitelisting + a static egress IP for a dedicated dev pool. Also need rough pricing delta for multi-region POC. Thanks!

liam (solutions): We can support EU + APAC. Subproc list: https://redwood-inference.com/docs/subprocessors (pointer). Note: China mainland is handled separately. ap-southeast-1 (SG) is generally supported but HSM-backed BYOK in APAC is gated — will confirm specific providers.

sophia (eng-ops): For Dedicated pools -> yes, we can allocate static NAT IPs per VPC to satisfy IP whitelist requests. For Hosted (shared) no hard static egress guarantee. For the POC we can create a dedicated dev pool in eu-west-1 + ap-southeast-1 staging. Estimated infra uplift: ~20–30% over single-region dev pool (depends on instance sizes).

devon (legal): BYOK in EU: standard. APAC: some regions require customer-managed KMS and extra contract language. I'll prepare the DPA addendum + subproc attestation template. Note: CN customers need an extra review cycle.

tara (sales): Also: customer wants per-tenant geofencing with failover rules — can we pin tenant to region and have a policy that prevents cross-border failover?

liam (solutions): Tenant pinning supported for Dedicated and Private (control plane only). Fallback behavior: by default we allow cross-region failover to keep the service up; strict no-cross-border geofence is available but it's an add-on and reduces failover options (and impacts SLA). Spell that out in the proposal.

sophia (eng-ops): For the POC propose: 2-week pilot, dedicated dev pools (EU + APAC), BYOK validation in EU first, staged BYOK in APAC behind HSM gating. Sample IP pieces for procurement: peer CIDR for peering: `10.0.0.0/22`, sample egress NAT IP (dev): `198.51.100.12`. I'll draft a short runbook with steps and blockers.

tara (sales): Can you drop a one-pager with costs, runbook blockers, and lead times by EOD? Procurement needs it for approval. How long for BYOK/HSM in APAC?

liam (solutions): Lead time for HSM setup in APAC is typically 4–6 weeks unless customer already has supported cloud KMS/HSM. If they have an existing supported KMS, we can shorten to ~1–2 weeks for validation. Cost one-pager incoming in ~2 hours.

devon (legal): I'll attach the DPA addendum + current subproc export. Reminder: if customer requires subproc local attestations we need 2 weeks for legal review.

sophia (eng-ops): tagging infra @ronen for capacity check — @ronen are there any capacity constraints in ap-southeast-1 for the next 30 days?

ronen (infra-oncall): ap-southeast-1 currently has 2 spare dedicated slots we can reserve. eu-west-1 has maintenance scheduled next week but can still accept a small dev pool. Ping me the resource IDs and I'll carve them out.

tara (sales): Great — I'll compile everything and loop in procurement and the customer. :thumbsup: 

liam (solutions): FYI I'll include the cost delta scenarios (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and note where pricing changes with strict-geofence and BYOK HSMs.

sophia (eng-ops): I'll upload the runbook + sample whitelist snippet to the deal thread after lunch.

tara (sales): Awesome — thanks everyone.
